title: Akbar ke Kaleje Me Sina Rahgayi Moula
body:
Akber key kalejey mein sinaa rehgayi moula
Zainab aseer-e-gham wo sitam she gayi moula
Ham shakl-e-payambar par qayamath ki ghadi hai
Barchi sina ki our phir uftaad nayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchi jawan key dil mein, jagah kar gayi moula
Kis darjah musibath hai haram par hai qayamath
Shadi key ghar mein akber-e-mehroo ki sahadath
Laila key dil se pucho, qayamath hui moula
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhegi kaisi laashe jawan laila dilafgaar
Wo zulm kiya akber-e-mahroo pa sitamgaar
Fizza pukari laashe, jawan aagayi moula
Dekhegi kaisa Zainab laash-e-jawan aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Har lamha har nafas yaha mehshar ki ghadi aayi
Hum shakle mohammed pe, qayamath hui moula
Wo chand si surat wo jigar moula ka lekar
Akber shaheed hogaye barchi ka phal wo khaa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum shakle payamber pe, kya guzri hai moula
Thi aarzu laila ki tera sehra mein dekhu
Jee bhar key tujhe npyaar karu qurbaan bhi hoolu
Ye aarzu laila ki bhi, faqad rehgayi moula
<<DIVIDER>>
Iqbal run mein pyasao ka wo haal hua hai
Atthara baras waala pyasa hi gaya hai
Laila ki ummidao par, churi chal gayi moula
